```{r proxy-data}
# Gender × ADHD presentation counts reported by Platania et al. (2025).
# Values are entered manually from the published source.

platania <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Gender,   ~subtype,          ~n,
  "Male",    "ADHD-I",          289,
  "Male",    "ADHD-HI",          12,
  "Male",    "ADHD-C",          525,
  "Male",    "other_specifed",    1,
  "Male",    "unspecified",       2,
  "Female",  "ADHD-I",          420,
  "Female",  "ADHD-HI",          32,
  "Female",  "ADHD-C",          832,
  "Female",  "other_specified",   10,
  "Female",  "unspecified",       6
)

valid_subtypes <- c("ADHD-I", "ADHD-HI", "ADHD-C")

platania_clean <- platania %>%
  filter(subtype %in% valid_subtypes)

#saving as df for reproducibiltiy:

```

```{r load-analysis-results}
analysis_files <- list.files(
  path = analysis_dir,
  pattern = "analysis_summary\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (length(analysis_files) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No analysis_summary.csv files found in: ",
    analysis_dir
  )

}

cat_metrics <- analysis_files %>%
  setNames(basename(.)) %>%
  lapply(read_csv, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "source_file") %>%
  mutate(
    Study = case_when(
      str_detect(source_file, "s1|S1") ~ "S1",
      str_detect(source_file, "s2|S2") ~ "S2",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Condition = case_when(
      str_detect(source_file, "ex_|explicit") ~ "Explicit",
      str_detect(source_file, "im_|implicit") ~ "Implicit",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    `Subtype(s)` = case_when(
      Study == "S1" ~ "ADHD-HI\n& ADHD-I",
      Study == "S2" ~ "ADHD-C",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Study = factor(Study, levels = c("S1", "S2")),
    Condition = factor(Condition, levels = c("Explicit", "Implicit"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Study, Condition) %>%
  select(Study, 
         Condition, 
         `Subtype(s)`, 
         LMS_total, 
         BS_total)

```

```{r Gender_within_subtype_table} 
gender_within_subtype <- platania_clean %>%
  group_by(subtype, Gender) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(subtype) %>%
  mutate(
    pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 2)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    subtype = factor(subtype, levels = c("ADHD-I", "ADHD-HI", "ADHD-C"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(subtype) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = Gender,
    values_from = c(n, pct),
    names_sep   = "_"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    total   = n_Male + n_Female,
    subtype = as.character(subtype)
  )

gender_within_total <- gender_within_subtype %>%
  bind_rows(
    gender_within_subtype %>%
      summarise(
        subtype    = "Total",
        n_Male     = sum(n_Male, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_Female   = sum(n_Female, na.rm = TRUE),
        pct_Male   = round(n_Male / (n_Male + n_Female) * 100, 2),
        pct_Female = round(n_Female / (n_Male + n_Female) * 100, 2),
        total      = sum(total, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
  )

gt_gender_table <- gender_within_total %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(
    subtype    = "Subtype",
    n_Male     = "Males (n)",
    pct_Male   = "Males (%)",
    n_Female   = "Females (n)",
    pct_Female = "Females (%)",
    total      = "Total (n)"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(n_Male, n_Female, total),
    decimals = 0
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(pct_Male, pct_Female),
    decimals = 2
  ) %>%
  theme_gt_paper() %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_fill(color = adjustcolor(col_male, alpha.f = 0.10)),
    locations = cells_body(columns = c(n_Male, pct_Male))
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_fill(color = adjustcolor(col_female, alpha.f = 0.10)),
    locations = cells_body(columns = c(n_Female, pct_Female))
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(style = "italic"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = c(pct_Male, pct_Female))
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(rows = subtype == "Total")
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_borders(
      sides = "top",
      style = "double",
      color = col_proxy
    ),
    locations = cells_body(rows = subtype == "Total")
  )

gt_gender_table

```
```{r}
gtsave(gt_gender_table,
       filename = file.path(table_dir, "gender_table.png"))
```

```{r CAT_metrics_table}
gt_cat_metrics_table <- cat_metrics %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(
    Study = "Study",
    Condition = "Condition",
    `Subtype(s)` = "Subtype(s)",
    LMS_total = html("LMS<sub>total</sub> (%)"),
    BS_total = html("BS<sub>total</sub> (%)")
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(LMS_total, BS_total),
    decimals = 2
  ) %>%
  theme_gt_paper() %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(style = "italic"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = c(LMS_total, BS_total))
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_borders(
      sides = "top",
      style = "double",
      color = col_proxy
    ),
    locations = cells_body(rows = Study == "S2" & Condition == "Explicit")
  )

gt_cat_metrics_table
```

```{r}
gtsave(
  gt_cat_metrics_table,
  filename = file.path(table_dir, "cat_metrics_table.png")
)
```

```{r}
platania_props <- platania_clean %>%
  group_by(Gender) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

platania_props
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=TRUE}
relative_proxy_dist <- ggplot(
  platania_props, aes(x = subtype, y = prop, fill = Gender)
  ) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.7, width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", prop)),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
    vjust = -0.6,
    size = 3.2
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Male" = col_male_proxy, "Female" = col_female_proxy), name ="Proxy gender"
    ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "ADHD subtype",
    y = "Proportion within proxy gender",
    # title = "Subtype distribution by Gender",
    # subtitle = "Platania proxy data"
  ) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 65),
    breaks = seq(0, 60, 15),
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))
  ) +
  theme_paper() +
theme(
  legend.position = "top",
  axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10))
)

relative_proxy_dist
